name: SOV-Transcribe-1

lineage.how_derived: speech-augmented LM: audio encoder, projector, MoE LLM

purpose: Open-weight speech-augmented LM for non-streaming ASR that organizations can run on their own infrastructure and keep audio data under their control (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card metadata: apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo. Canonical Apache-2.0 text read in the Qwen repo (canonical Apache-2.0 text read in https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR/blob/main/LICENSE). Built on Gemma 4 (Apache-2.0) and Whisper large-v3 (MIT).

architecture.kind: AUTOREGRESSIVE speech-augmented LLM: Whisper large-v3 encoder + projector + Gemma 4 26B-A4B MoE (decode memory-bound)
architecture.drafter: DFlash speculative decoding with a separate draft model (about 2-3x single-request speed per card)

pc-24gb.notes: 4-bit needs a quantized runtime, none known

engine_support.notes: Gemma 4 MoE decoder; reference deployment RTX PRO 6000 96 GB

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis non-streaming STT rank among open weights
German WER, Open ASR multilingual track (6 of 8 datasets)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, German column (WER %), read from the Space config JSON 2026-11-19; rows differ in how many of the 8 datasets they cover

benchmarks.name: Open ASR English avg WER (leaderboard rank 10 of 69)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard English track, read 2026-11-19

benchmarks.name: RTFx on the leaderboard (English track, leaderboard GPU)

strengths: Open-weight #1 on a third-party leaderboard (Artificial Analysis) per the card
weaknesses: Tested to 30 min per file; longer needs splitting
Occasional repetition loops until token limit
Claims strongest for English; no per-language table in text
soft.maturity: Very new (HF createdAt 2026-11-10), 91 likes, 826 downloads, no user reports found.

tona_fit.reason: Quality fine (German 4.12 on 6 of 8 sets, English rank 10 of 69) and Apache-2.0, but 26.6B total / 4.6B active needs 24-32 GB or more; 12-16 GB classes do not fit and there is no quantised runtime. The decoder is Gemma 4 26B-A4B: a Tona Gemma 4 MoE backend plus a Whisper encoder would serve it.

open_questions: Quantised size and any GGML runtime
